changes.title: Glow trail
items: Her trail is now a glow behind her broom like the ley lines, in the colour of the area she's over: up to 5 m on the ground and 20 m over the treetops, longer the faster she flies

changes.title: Sleepy faces
items: Sleeping legends show a sleepy face in their dream bubble: mostly 😴, now and then a yawn, a sigh or a contented smile

changes.title: Planted feet
items: Creatures' feet stay planted on the ground as they walk: no more sliding, walking in place, or gliding with still legs
Their stride matches how fast they go, and they stop stepping when they stop
